summary: A booking product that lets a holder delegate one narrowly bounded recovery to a verified human-backed agent, without surrendering wallet or account control.

continuity.summaryBefore: Hedera-native booking product with tokenized booking rights on HTS, booking/resale/recovery flows, provider-controlled rules, and HCS, Mirror and Schedule Service proof surfaces. Recovery was performed by the customer; all writes ran through trusted backend code on server-managed accounts, with no delegation, replay protection, identity layer or hardware authorization.
summaryAddedDuringEvent: Bounded Recovery Mandate binding owner, agent, booking, action, minimum recovery, settlement asset, expiry, cancellation policy and nonce
Current-authority projection re-resolved on every request, with expiry and authority-version enforcement
AgentKit signature verification bound to exact resource, statement, operation and intent
AgentBook agent resolution and nonce-backed replay rejection
Explicit boundary keeping requester identity separate from booking authority
Operation-scoped provider policy, buyer eligibility and payment records
Exact buyer-funded payment authorization bound to the operation
Seller-net minimum semantics rather than gross
Single begin-effect boundary with durable retained unsigned transaction bytes
External-signing validation, one-shot dispatch fencing and indexed receipt reconciliation

productDemo.journey: Maya holds a Friday Yoga booking she cannot use and authorizes recovery with a 40 USDC net minimum. Studio A's provider policy remains independent. A 32 USDC offer is rejected with no payment attempted. A 45 USDC offer passes mandate, provider policy, buyer eligibility, payment and current booking checks. Bob becomes holder, finds the booking under My Bookings and checks in. Studio A sees Bob as holder and fulfils. Maya retains her recovery receipt, and later fulfilment does not rewrite the successful recovery.

ledger.role: Defines what the human allows. A structured Recovery Mandate turns a blanket approval into a narrow, expiring, replay-protected capability that the server cannot widen.
eventDelta: Out-of-band device ceremony isolated from application credentials
boundaries: Ledger authorizes the Recovery Mandate; it does not sign the Hedera settlement transaction
Physical device evidence covers the rejection path and is not presented as device-approved provenance

world.role: Proves who is asking to act. Verifies that the requester is the registered human-backed agent the mandate names, without granting booking authority.
eventDelta: AgentKit signature verification bound to exact resource, statement, operation and intent
Trust boundary separating identity from authorization
boundaries: AgentBook registration and resolution evidence is live
World ID Sandbox evidence is real and non-production
Verified requester identity is not booking ownership, holder authority or permission to settle

hedera.role: Enforces and records what actually happened. Booking rights are serial-scoped tokens, settlement is stable-value, and ownership and transfers are independently readable through Mirror.
eventDelta: Current provider, holder, eligibility and payment state re-read at request time
External-signing validation before signing and before submission

historicalTestnetTransaction.proves: One booking NFT and a flat 45 USDC moved together in a single atomic Hedera transaction
historicalTestnetTransaction.doesNotProve: The newer 40.5 / 4.5 demo royalty economics, or atomicity of the cross-system workflow

boundaries: Atomicity applies to the single Hedera transaction boundary only, not the whole workflow
The public confirmation route stops at retained unsigned transaction bytes and does not sign or submit automatically

verification.browserQaScope: Local browser QA executed against the exact submission package: holder navigation, booking navigation, integrity, connected-actor and full product journey suites, at desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844, with zero server errors.

claimBoundaries: The product journey is a deterministic fixture demonstrating real product behavior, not live settlement
AgentBook resolution is live; World ID Sandbox evidence is real and non-production
Physical Ledger evidence covers the rejection path only and is not an approval
The historical Hedera transaction moved a flat 45 USDC and does not demonstrate the 40.5 / 4.5 demo royalty split
No single continuous live Ledger to World to Hedera execution is claimed
